title: Pyramid of the Sun
visualBrief: Specific Pyramid of the Sun exterior: five mapped sloping stages, horizontal terraces and flat summit; continuous west stair flights, landings and independently mapped projecting lower U-shaped platforms. No intact summit temple, individual stone inventory, visitors or hidden interiors.

geographicProposal.notes: Q29238/relation3373254 identifies the pyramid. Standard pinned PMTiles principal building52776561506502 and24 roof/platform parts define the225m main base, west projection, terrace edges and signed15.53-degree axis. The full parent outline including projections is236×222m. Reviewed approximate fit to the unchanged161-square/6m standard DEM. West-approach terrain reference replaces the existing central mound rather than stacking the model above it. All four levels close the occupied-footprint cutout;25 pyramid/terrace records are replaced and86 independent tile buildings are preserved exactly. Failed loading retains all111 records and the original terrain mound. Eviction restores ground and disposes all model geometry. Partial128m residency retains terrain outside its loaded domain;the empty-semantic partial fixture proves clipping/lifecycle only,not full-site contact at temporary boundaries. Partial-boundary gaps remain an explicit renderer limitation.
